title: narcissus sylvestris var. johnstonii
intro: Narcissus sylvestris var. johnstonii, commonly known as the Wild Jonquil or Jonquil, is a type of flowering bulbous plant belonging to the Amaryllidaceae family. The Wild Jonquil has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including its ability to help with respiratory issues and as a natural expectorant to relieve coughs. The therapeutic actions of Narcissus sylvestris var. johnstonii include its anti-inflammatory and antispasmodic properties, which can help to soothe and calm the body. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids such as galantamine and lycorine, which have been shown to possess neuroprotective and antimicrobial properties.
